title: More Vino Brentwood: TT$175 Restaurant Week four-course menu
summary: More Vino Brentwood has a TT$175 all-inclusive four-course Restaurant Week menu with seafood and sushi choices, extended through October 11.
description: For Trinidad & Tobago Restaurant Week 2026, More Vino offers a starter, one appetiser, one entree and one dessert for TT$175 with taxes included. The official extension notice lists its Brentwood location through October 11, 2026; the menu is available for dine-in or takeaway. Pescatarian choices listed include shrimp and vegetable tempura, Thai green curry shrimp and the Emperor Salmon Roll. The published menu does not provide dairy-allergen details, so dairy-free suitability is unconfirmed and should be checked with the restaurant before ordering.

price.label: TT$175; all taxes included
price.terms: Starter + 1 appetiser + 1 entree + 1 dessert. Available at Brentwood for dine-in or takeaway.
